name: CommandProcessorHost
responsibilities: Receives meter commands from the Scheduler
Validates commands against the meter's current DCW
Dispatches validated commands to the mesh network via collectors
typical_failures: Firmware/DCW mismatch after upgrade without GEI
Command payload built against a stale DCW version
Command queue backlog under high load
known_bugs: GLP commands return a Ping response when DCW is stale (no GEI sent post-upgrade)
playbooks: Check GEI sent after firmware upgrade
Compare GLP payload against expected DCW

name: CommandPayloadProcessorHost
responsibilities: Builds the binary command payload for a validated command
Encodes command parameters according to the meter's DCW
typical_failures: Payload encoding mismatch when DCW version is stale
Unsupported command type for the meter's firmware
playbooks: Review CommandPayloadProcessorHost log for encoding errors

name: MsgProcCmdRspHost
responsibilities: Receives and parses command responses from meters
Matches responses back to the originating command log entry
Flags mismatched or unexpected response types
typical_failures: Response type mismatch (e.g. a Ping response returned instead of GLP)
Response timeout not correlated back to the command log
known_bugs: Get Load Profile command returning a Ping response for stale-DCW meters
playbooks: Compare expected vs actual response type
Review CommandLogId correlation across CommandProcessorHost and MsgProcCmdRspHost

name: Scheduler
responsibilities: Schedules and queues meter commands based on business rules and priority
Triggers periodic jobs (load profile collection, firmware pushes)
typical_failures: Job backlog due to downstream CommandProcessorHost slowdown
Retry storm after a mass timeout event
Misconfigured schedule causing duplicate command submission
common_sql: SELECT * FROM ScheduledJob WHERE Status = 'Failed' ORDER BY ScheduledTime DESC
playbooks: Check for job backlog in the Scheduler queue
Verify the retry policy hasn't triggered a retry storm

name: GapRecon
responsibilities: Detects gaps in expected meter data (e.g. missing interval reads)
Reconciles missing data by scheduling backfill commands via the Scheduler
Reports unresolved gaps for engineer review
typical_failures: Gap detection false positives after a collector outage
Backfill commands not submitted due to Scheduler backlog
Reconciliation loop stalls on persistently unreachable meters
common_sql: SELECT * FROM DataGap WHERE Status = 'Open' ORDER BY DetectedAt DESC
documentation_links: Playbook: Low reads / missing interval data triage
playbooks: Check the DataGap table for unresolved gaps
Confirm backfill commands were submitted to the Scheduler

name: NMS
responsibilities: Monitors mesh network and collector health
Tracks device connectivity and RF signal quality
Raises alarms for network-level failures (collector down, mesh segment unreachable)
typical_failures: False alarms during firmware rollout windows
Alarm storm after a mesh router firmware regression
Stale connectivity status due to polling delay
common_sql: SELECT * FROM NetworkAlarm WHERE Status = 'Active' ORDER BY RaisedAt DESC
known_bugs: Mesh routers on firmware v3.4.0 intermittently stop forwarding commands
playbooks: Check NMS for active alarms on the affected collector/segment
